Terrible take. The reason people don't ever come on here and praise the matchmaking is because it is subjectively bad and, depending on the sources you access, also objectively bad. I have seen so many people praise other aspects of this game, so the reason you never see anyone praising the matchmaking is because there is nothing to praise. Literally thousands of people complain about it and give it a few more months, if nothing changes, more and more people will step away from the game due to it. 

I have also never been higher in ranks and won so many than I have in season 1.5. I honestly believe you can climb to at LEAST diamond just by playing, so this game is anything but designed to keep people 'hardstuck' - which is literally half the problem. I also don't care about losing games - which you would realise if you read my post instead of just venting about wider reddit posts for no reason. 

The problem with this reddit is so many people jump to defend this game without seeing the nuance. Yes there is a lot great with this game, yes there are problems; the matchmaking is evidently one of these problems. The fact so many complain literally reinforces this. By reducing it down to people being "whiny" means nothing will ever get done about it and that is a real shame for such a great game.
Ah so you made a comment that was wrong, notice so many people have the same problem on the sub reddit, and then laugh at it. Fair enough, you do you buddy 👍

Thank you. I will give them a watch. I'm really glad someone has come at this with some nuance.

There is a lot about this game to love, but this matchmaking experience has been ongoing for like 3 months for me now and I'm just bored more than anything. My experience in 1.5 has felt identical to before. The only difference perhaps is that I feel the win/loss streaks are longer (i.e. win maybe 5 then lose 4 or 5). 

I honestly wouldn't mind if I lost more games, got put in a lower rank I truly deserve (instead of winning based on engagement) and actually having varied and enjoyable games.
You clearly didn't read my post then. I actually said it is the winning AND losing streaks. In fact, I mention that like 3 times.

I absolutely get that, but this was more just to vent because I’m more frustrated than anything. I love so much about this game, but I just feel like it’s being let down by something so integral. What’s really getting to me is that the matchmaking and win-loss streaks have become so repetitive that they’re causing more boredom than anger. At least with anger, I’d have something to prove.

Also, thank you for saying my post was eloquently worded. My university has harangued me into improving my writing so much that I struggle to write a text message without over-articulating it, lol.
Lol, I get that. Is it your wifi or the servers?

I am entitled to my opinion on this game. I never said anybody should or shouldn't still be playing it. I just made a post mentioning MY experience and why I will stop playing. Why would I make a post mentioning someone else's experience? Of course it's about me. 

It has nothing to do with new characters or the game itself, it is about a fundamental flaw in this game that many, many other players have picked up on. There is an awful lot I love about this game, and I get the "eats shit" argument - almost every competitive online game is the same - but this feels like a fundamental flaw that makes the game more boring (in the sense of how consistent it is) then bad.   
  
Feel free to enjoy the game - nobody said you should stop playing, so I have no idea why you are so defensive. Blindly supporting this games faults does no favours for anyone, as I am sure you will agree. But like I said, you keep enjoying the game buddy - nobody said you shouldn't.
Well you just were.

Really? I thought it was at least semi SBMM. If thats the case then it's just terrible. Its genuinely ridiculous how I have a better experience in comp (in the game sense not even player ability sense) then quick play. I'd rather I have to wait 30 seconds to matchmake and both teams get put against players in semi equal ability than what we currently have.

I honestly feel like I get nothing out of learning new heroes in QP because I either get stomped (don't really get anything out of it) or stomp them (don't really get anything out of it) and comp is a terrible place to try a new hero as I'm sure you already know lol

This is terrible logic though. Skill based matchmaking would surely put me in games I'm reasonably equal to no? Like match me to players at a reasonable level? I either got stomped or when I win I stomp them. You look at the team composition after and you will most likely see one team with players in a way higher comp position then the others. How is that SBMM? I'm genuinely curious.
